t11.rationale: The complete shared Windows-path helper owns separator replacement and the drive-prefix condition. Its callers are not automatically part of this minimal author-declared scope.

t12.rationale: This retained path-manipulation library has no HTTP server, TLS rotation or connection-pool implementation. A new subsystem has no established target; safe bypass is the declared normative expectation, not proof of no potentially useful surrounding code.

tasks.prompt: Review human-readable byte-size formatting at rounding boundaries: a mantissa rounded to the unit base should advance the suffix when a larger unit exists. Preserve negative values, binary units and compact GNU-style output.
Natural-language lists should handle empty, singleton, two-item and longer iterables with consistent separators. Review conversion of each item to text so one-shot generators are consumed only once.
The output is wrong. Fix the issue.

Review checkbox task-item rewriting: lowercase and uppercase x should mark checked state, the marker should be removed from the first text block, and nested task items should still be rewritten without changing ordinary list items.

Review inline and display mathematics parsing so escaped delimiters remain intact and token types distinguish inline content from display content. Preserve registration of mathematical blocks inside quotes and lists.
Implement a PostgreSQL transaction coordinator with deadlock retries and connection-pool isolation.

Review strict JSON parsing so malformed inputs and prototype-pollution keys are rejected, while permissive parsing retains its fallback behavior. Trace strict-option propagation and dangerous-key handling in the maintained implementation.

Review the quoted-string fast path so escape sequences and surrounding whitespace remain consistent with normal JSON parsing. Preserve boolean, null, NaN and infinity handling, and leave non-string inputs unchanged.
The behavior is wrong; make the implementation better.

Review extraction of a filename across both directory-separator styles: preserve leading-dot names and remove only the final extension. Handle empty input and trailing separators without changing alias-expansion behavior.

Review Windows separator and drive-letter normalization. Convert backslashes to slashes and uppercase a lowercase drive only for absolute drive paths, while preserving empty input and relative drive forms.
Implement an HTTP/2 server connection pool with TLS certificate rotation and request retries.
